fold_generation.repeat_rule: one per-pair RNG; choose held-out blocks sequentially for repeats 1..5 without using outcomes
fold_generation.insufficient_spatial_blocks_rule: write all five declared folds as failed placeholders; retain them as zero in intention-to-evaluate

recovery.random_seed_rule: pass random_seed_base + pair_id*10000 + repeat*1009 to the frozen dense evaluator; its pre-existing draw RNG adds 991 internally
recovery.failure_rule: any declared fold that cannot be exported or evaluated contributes recall=0, random_mean_recall=0, lift=0

inference.pair_value: mean lift_over_random across five declared folds at support_fraction=0.025 and radius_km=10
inference.success_gate: overall mean lift >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND one-sided sign-flip p < 0.05 AND plant mean lift > 0 AND animal mean lift > 0
